description: This file defines data classes, interfaces, and implementation for handling motion activity and pedometer data, primarily using Android sensors. It includes sensor data collection, classification logic, permission checks, and a handler class for processing requests related to motion data, exposing methods for activity and pedometer info.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a motion activity data request with optional start and end ISO times and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class for pedometer data request, specifying optional start and end ISO times.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class representing an activity record with timestamps, confidence, and activity type booleans.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class representing pedometer data with timestamps, steps, distance, and floors ascended/descended.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check availability, permissions, and retrieve activity and pedometer data.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing MotionDataSource, utilizing Android sensors for actual data collection and classification.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class exposing methods to handle motion activity and pedometer requests, providing permission checks and data retrieval, designed for integration with gateway sessions.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles motion activity request, verifies permission, retrieves activity data, and formats as JSON.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles pedometer request, verifies permission, retrieves pedometer data, and formats as JSON.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if motion data capabilities are available on the device.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity sensor data is available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer sensor data is available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into MotionActivityRequest with validation.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into MotionPedometerRequest with validation.
